tasks.title: Activity Update Notes
tasks.description: A raw note appended directly to an entity (project, task, area, etc.) with no AI extraction pipeline. The note is linked via a new `activity_update` relationship type and is used only for summary context. Creates: new API endpoint, new MCP tool, UI section and input.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v4/entities/<id>/activity_updates creates a note with source='activity_update', links it with relationship_type='activity_update', and touches the target entity's updated_at
The same content within 24h on the same target entity is skipped (duplicate prevention)
Maximum 30 activity_update notes per target entity; returns 409 when cap is reached
Deleting or archiving an entity cascades delete/archive to all its incoming activity_update notes
MCP tool append_activity_update(entity_id, content) calls the new API endpoint
UI shows an 'Activity Updates' section in entity detail for types that support it (project, task, area)
UI has an 'Add activity update' input/textarea in the Activity Updates section
Validation: PYTHONPATH=. ./venv/bin/pytest -q passes; cd ui && npm run build passes
validationCommands: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
